prompt.description: The text prompt describing the music you want to generate. Include genre, mood, instrumentation, tempo, vocals, and structure for best results. Lyria 3.5 supports full-length songs up to a few minutes — use timestamps or duration hints in your prompt to control song length, e.g. 'a 2-minute track' or section markers like '[0:00-0:30] Intro: ...' / '[0:30-1:00] Verse: ...'. Supports English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Portuguese.
prompt.title: Prompt

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

image_url.description: Optional image URL to use as visual inspiration for music generation. The model will create music that matches the mood and theme of the image.
image_url.title: Image Url

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompting is not supported by Lyria 3.5.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

audio.description: The generated music as an MP3 file.
audio.title: File

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

lyrics.description: The generated or provided lyrics for the track, if applicable.
examples:
[[A0]]
[[B1]]
[12.0:] Dust motes dancing in the light,
[:] Morning breaks so soft and white.
lyrics.title: Lyrics
